none: PAS NLM-95B65B: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Diademed bust right. Obverse inscription: CON[---]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them; a vexillum on standard may depict Victory. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 14.4mm, Weight: 1.51gms, die axis: 6
